records.title: P91 PPF Basic - Hatchback
records.description: Complete Paint Protection Film coverage for hatchback vehicles. Our premium PPF protects your car from stone chips, scratches, bird droppings, and UV damage while maintaining the original paint finish.
records.whyChoose: Paint protection film puts a clear urethane layer between your hatchback and the road. The bonnet, bumper and mirror backs take the constant low-level impacts of city and highway driving, and the film absorbs them instead of the clearcoat. Light scratching from washing and drying collects in the film, so the panel underneath stays in the condition it was in when the film went on. The film is optically clear, so the colour and gloss you see are still your own paint. Factory paint is only original once; fitting film over it protects that finish rather than repairing it later.

process.description: We inspect the paint before anything is fitted, so the starting condition is clear.

process.title: Full decontamination
process.description: The car is washed and decontaminated so the film goes onto a clean surface.

process.title: Film cut and fitted panel by panel
process.description: The film is cut and fitted one panel at a time.

process.title: Final inspection
process.description: Every panel is checked before the car is handed over.

process.title: Handover with written warranty terms
process.description: You receive the warranty terms in writing when you collect the car.

faq.answer: This package lists: Full body PPF coverage; Self-healing technology; 5-year warranty; Stone chip protection; UV protection; Hydrophobic coating. It is fitted to a hatchback at our studio in Adugodi, Bangalore.

faq.answer: This package lists a 5-year warranty. Warranty on any job is the film manufacturer's, issued in writing at handover.

faq.answer: At our studio: 49, 13th Cross, Ayappa Garden, Adugodi, Bengaluru 560030. Call +91 74066 19191 if you need directions or want to check a slot.
faq.question: Where is the work done?

faq.answer: Paint protection film is a physical film that absorbs stone chips and washing marks. Ceramic coating is a liquid layer that adds gloss and repels water and dirt. Our guide "PPF vs Ceramic Coating" at /blog/ppf-vs-ceramic-coating-bangalore compares the two for Bangalore conditions.
faq.question: How is paint protection film different from ceramic coating?
